page_title: ANG 0-1 LIL | Angers v Lille 22/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Mathieu Vernice has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Ousmane Camara (Angers) argues with the referee and is booked for dissent.
88' Dangerous play by Branco van den Boomen (Angers). Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle for a foul. Lille get a free kick.
84' The game has come to an end for Calvin Verdonk. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Romain Perraud (Lille).
83' Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) meets a splendid cross on the edge of the 6-yard box and sends the ball towards the left post, forcing Berke Ozer into a superb diving save to keep it out.
81' Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. A free kick to Lille.
79' It's time for a substitution. Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) comes on in place of Felix Correia.
79' That will be all from Olivier Giroud who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Ngalayel Mukau (Lille).
78' Here comes a substitution. Florent Hanin (Angers) is brought on as a substitute for Jacques Ekomie.
78' Alexandre Dujeux decides to make a substitution. Louis Mouton will be replaced by Prosper Peter (Angers).
74' Calvin Verdonk (Lille) commits a rough challenge and Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Angers.
73' Gaetan Perrin will be replaced by Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille).
73' Berke Ozer (Lille) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
72' Berke Ozer (Lille) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
70' The free kick from long range, taken by Angers, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
69' Tiago Santos (Lille) commits a rough challenge and Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick has been awarded to Angers.
67' Substitution. Harouna Djibirin (Angers) has come on for Haris Belkebla.
64' Gaetan Perrin (Lille) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Angers will take a free kick.
64' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Angers.
61' Lille have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
59' Lille force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
57' Amine Sbai (Angers) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Lille earn a free kick.
56' None of the Angers players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

52' Ousmane Camara (Angers) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Mathieu Vernice no option but to blow his whistle. Free kick. Lille will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
50' Lille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

50' Nathan Ngoy (Lille) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range towards the top right corner, but Herve Koffi was alert and made an amazing save! The ball goes out of play and Lille have been awarded a corner kick.
49' The resulting set piece from Lille is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

48' Aissa Mandi (Lille) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just wide of the left post. Unlucky! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
48' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Matias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) inside the box. The referee blows his whistle, Lille are awarded a corner kick.
47' Lille earn a corner.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' 0 - 1 Goal! Olivier Giroud (Lille) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Herve Koffi into the bottom right corner.
45+1' Olivier Giroud (Lille) is going to take the penalty!
45' Jordan Lefort (Angers) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. Penalty! A huge opportunity to score for Lille.
42' Matias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) is penalised for a foul. Mathieu Vernice had a clear view and blows his whistle. Angers are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
42' A cross from a corner kick by Lille is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
39' Lille fail to score from a corner as Herve Koffi (Angers) leaps to collect the ball.
37' Ousmane Camara (Angers) is flagged for offside.
36' Nathan Ngoy (Lille) has tested the patience of referee Mathieu Vernice and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
35' The Lille players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
34' It looks like Jacques Ekomie (Angers) saw red with that tackle. Mathieu Vernice won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Lille are awarded a free kick.
32' Goduine Koyalipou (Angers) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
32' Goduine Koyalipou (Angers) gets on the end of the free kick, but somehow sends his header well wide of the left post from close in. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
30' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Calvin Verdonk (Lille) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Angers.
27' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) was quite harsh and Mathieu Vernice didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

25' Olivier Giroud (Lille) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Angers, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
21' Mathieu Vernice shows a yellow card to Branco van den Boomen (Angers) for his blatant foul.
19' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lille, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
18' Jacques Ekomie (Angers) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Lille are awarded the free kick.
17' Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle. Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) commits a foul after dangerous play. Lille will take a free kick near the side line.
12' Matias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the roof of the net, but Herve Koffi pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
8' A pass from Amine Sbai (Angers) is intercepted by Berke Ozer and the move breaks down.

6' A clever short pass gives Felix Correia (Lille) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.
5' Great teamplay by Lille as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Angers will kick the game off.
Mathieu Vernice will supervise the game today.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
